sound.label: Sound
sound.description: Play a tone with each notification.

led.label: Blink LED
led.description: Blink the status LED in the notification's colour.

usage.label: Show usage
usage.description: After a finished turn, show how much of the 5-hour and weekly limits is used.

wait.label: Answer time
wait.description: How long a permission prompt waits for a button. A question waits at least 30 seconds. The long times hold up the session until you answer or it runs out.
